resources.string: Companion app for Local Study AI: natural offline voices for reading aloud (German: Thorsten, English: LJSpeech). Local Study AI uses them automatically once this app is installed. You can also choose it as the default speech engine in your device settings.
Ready: the voices are built in and work without internet.
The voice data is missing in this installation.
This app needs no permissions, sends nothing and stores nothing except unpacked speech data. Everything runs on your device.
